test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A few of the letters are given followed by a question mark (?). These letters follow a specific pattern you have to give the correct option which can replace the question mark

Find the next letter in the series: A, B, D, H, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a6c1b703839665531bdb563757a69596253472c8767fec6930d8c04ec6c17a5.png] 

The logic followed here is:

A + 1 = B

B + 2 = D

D + 4 = H

H + 8 = P

So, '**P**' will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
